login.loginHint: Sign in with your admin password.
login.passwordMin8: Password must be at least 8 characters

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.syncHistoryLink: View sync history — retry failed runs

users.title: Users
users.intro: Each user can link iCloud and/or Google Photos. Use per-provider Count and Sync on the user detail page. For dual-source downloads, set path template to include {source} (e.g. {source}/YYYY/MM/DD/{filename}).
users.addHint: Provide a display name and/or Apple ID. Google Photos can be linked later on the user page. At least one label is required.
users.fetchOnCreate: Fetch iCloud photo count after adding (no download)
users.empty: No users yet. Add an Apple ID above — you can fetch the photo count before syncing.

syncRuns.title: Sync Runs
syncRuns.intro: Re-run a failed or completed sync from the Actions column, or open the user page.

authorize.title: Authorize iCloud
authorize.authorizeTitle: Sign in to iCloud with Apple ID password
authorize.step1: Step 1 — enter your Apple ID password (not an app-specific password unless you use one for iCloud). If 2FA is enabled, you will be asked for a code next.
authorize.requirements: Requires “Access iCloud Data on the Web” on the device and Advanced Data Protection turned off. See user page for details.
authorize.step2: Step 2 — enter the 6-digit code. You only need one code (from the Mac/iPhone popup or SMS — they are usually the same).
authorize.telegramHint: Do not click Sign in again — that sends another code. Or send /code 123456 to your Telegram bot in a private chat.
authorize.sessionExpired: Session expired — enter your password and sign in again.

google.completeSignIn: Complete sign-in in the Google tab, then return here

userDetail.subtitle: User #{{id}} · iCloud + Google Photos · use {source}/ in path template for dual-source
userDetail.syncInProgress: Sync in progress — this page refreshes automatically
userDetail.icloudDesc: Authorize with Apple ID, password, and 2FA. Count indexes metadata; Sync downloads files.
userDetail.icloudDescConnected: iCloud is connected. Count indexes metadata; Sync downloads pending photos.
userDetail.icloudDescNotLinked: No Apple ID on this user — add one under Storage & profile to use iCloud.
userDetail.icloudDescNotAuthorized: Sign in with your Apple ID password (and 2FA if enabled) to connect iCloud.
userDetail.icloudDescAwaiting2fa: A verification code was sent — enter it below (or via Telegram /code). Do not start a new sign-in.
userDetail.icloudDescReauth: iCloud needs sign-in again before Count or Sync will work.
userDetail.icloudDescExpired: Trusted iCloud session expired — sign in again to continue syncing.
userDetail.setAppleId: Set an Apple ID in Storage & profile below to use iCloud.
userDetail.icloudHelp1: On iPhone/iPad: Settings → Apple ID → iCloud → Access iCloud Data on the Web must be on.
userDetail.icloudHelp2: Advanced Data Protection must be off (blocks server photo API).
userDetail.icloudHelp3: Use your Apple ID password; if 2FA is enabled, approve on a trusted device or send /code 123456 to your Telegram bot (when Telegram is enabled in Settings).
userDetail.countSyncHelp: Count iCloud — scans the library into the database (no files). Sync iCloud — downloads pending photos only.
userDetail.googleDesc: One-time OAuth per user. App credentials are configured under Settings → Google Photos OAuth.
userDetail.googleDescConnected: Google Photos is connected. Count indexes metadata; Sync downloads pending photos.
userDetail.googleDescNotLinked: Not connected — use Connect Google Photos below (OAuth once per user).
userDetail.googleDescNotAuthorized: Connect your Google account to index and download photos.
userDetail.googleDescReauth: Google connection needs refresh — reconnect below.
userDetail.googleStep1: In Settings: Google OAuth client ID + secret, and server TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY in .env.
userDetail.googleStep2: Click Connect Google Photos below and sign in with the Google account that owns the library.
userDetail.googleStep3: Use Count Google then Sync Google (same as iCloud).
userDetail.googleConnectHelp: Opens Google sign-in in a new tab. After approving, you are redirected back to this user page. If connect fails, check redirect URI in Google Cloud matches Settings.
userDetail.scheduleDesc: The background worker runs a full download on this interval when scheduling is enabled.
userDetail.scheduledSyncOffManualOk: Scheduled sync is off; you can still use Count and Sync manually below.
userDetail.saveAppleIdFirst: Save Apple ID under Storage & profile first
userDetail.signInIcloudFirst: Authorize iCloud first (full session required for download)
userDetail.storageDesc: Photos are saved under the download directory using the global path template from Settings.
userDetail.downloadDirHelp: Absolute path on the server. Must match an Immich external library import path if you use Immich. For iCloud + Google, use a path template with {source} in Settings.
userDetail.immichDesc: Link this Apple ID to an Immich external library. Server URL and API key are configured in Settings.
userDetail.immichConnect: Connect this user as an Immich external library
userDetail.librariesLoadError: Could not load libraries — configure Immich in Settings or paste the UUID manually.
userDetail.immichPathHelp: Download directory must be inside that library's import path in Immich. After each successful sync, a library scan is triggered.
userDetail.syncAllDesc: Runs iCloud and Google in parallel. The scheduler uses this same behavior on each user's interval.
userDetail.syncAllHelp: Blocked while a full all sync is already running. Per-provider sync buttons can still run side by side (e.g. iCloud + Google at once).
userDetail.resetNextSyncTitle: Set next sync to now + interval
userDetail.deleteUserHint: Removes this user, sync history, and photo records from the database. Files already on disk are not deleted.
userDetail.deleteUserConfirm: Permanently delete {{name}} and all sync history for this account? Downloaded files on disk are not removed automatically.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Values saved here are stored in the database. Some secrets must still be set in the server .env file (see Google Photos section). Restart the worker after changing the Telegram bot token.
settings.adminLoginHelp: Password for this web UI only. On first visit, use the login screen to create the initial admin account (stored as a bcrypt hash in the database).
settings.keepPassword: Leave blank to keep current password
settings.passwordAlreadySet: A password is already stored. Enter a new one only to change it.
settings.telegramHelp2: Send <1>/newbot</1>, follow prompts, then copy the <2>HTTP API token</2> (looks like <3>123456789:AAH…</3>).
settings.telegramHelp3: When iCloud asks for 2FA, open your bot in Telegram and send /code 123456 (replace with the code you received).
settings.testBotHelp: Checks the token with Telegram (getMe). Save the bot token first, and enable Telegram so the worker starts the bot for /code.
settings.testMessageFailed: Invalid token — check the value from @BotFather, then Save
settings.pathTemplateHelp: Use / between folders. Tokens: YYYY, YY, MM, DD, HH, mm, ss, {source}, and {filename}. For iCloud + Google on one user, include {source} so files do not overwrite each other.
settings.baseDirHelp: Set BASE_DOWNLOAD_DIR in .env. Each user also has their own folder under this path.
settings.immichHelp: Connects to your Immich server for optional library scans after sync. Per-user external library ID is set on each user page.
settings.immichHelpTitle: Where to get Immich API key
settings.immichHelp1: Open your Immich web app → <1>Account settings</1> (avatar menu).
settings.immichHelp2: <1>API Keys</1> → Create key with permissions <2>library.read</2> and <3>library.update</3> (or admin key for testing).
settings.immichHelp3: Copy the key once shown — Immich does not display it again.
settings.immichHelp4: External library UUID: Immich → <1>Administration</1> → External libraries → open library → copy ID from URL or settings.
settings.immichUrlHelp: Public base URL of Immich (no trailing slash), same host you use in the browser.
settings.scanDebounceHelp: Minimum seconds between scan requests for the same library.
settings.googleOAuthHelp: Global OAuth app credentials. Each user connects their own Google account on their user page. Refresh tokens are encrypted in the database.
settings.tokenKeyMissing: TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set in .env — Google connect will fail until you add it and restart the API/worker. Generate:
settings.serverEnvWebUrl: <1>WEB_PUBLIC_BASE_URL</1> — exact URL you use to open this app (e.g. <2>{{url}}</2>). Must match Google redirect host.
settings.serverEnvTokenKey: <1>TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY</1> — Fernet key from the command above. Back up with your database; losing it invalidates stored Google tokens.
settings.googleConsole1: <1>Google Cloud Console</1> → create or select a project.
settings.googleConsole3: <1>APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen</1> → configure (External + test users, or publish app).
settings.googleConsole4: <1>Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID</1> → type <2>Web application</2>.
settings.googleConsole6: Copy <1>Client ID</1> and <2>Client secret</2> below, then Save.
settings.oauthClientIdHelp: From Google Cloud → Credentials → your OAuth 2.0 Client ID.
settings.oauthSecretHelp: Shown once when the client is created. Store only here (database), not in git.
settings.loggingHelp: When enabled, DEBUG-level messages are written to the database (up to 5,000 rows) and duplicated to the API/daemon console. The web UI also logs API calls to the browser console.
settings.defaultSyncHelp: Default for new users. Each user can override on their profile.
settings.maxConcurrentHelp: Split across providers when iCloud and Google sync overlap.
settings.schedulerPollHelp: How often the worker checks for users due for scheduled sync.
